summary: Optional rotation is validated and a shared occupied-extent helper consistently applies quarter-turn dimension swaps to clearance, board bounds, centers/net spans and SVG. Top-left placement and existing output structure remain intact. No concrete correctness or scope defect found.

assessment.schema: submitted/main.my:115-133 combines exact component field count with all original required fields, permits only the new optional rotation, and uses a missing-only integer default followed by the exact 0/90/180/270 set. Null, boolean, float, unsupported angles and unrelated extras reject in the schema phase.
assessment.geometry: occupied_extent at lines 333-339 exchanges width/height only for 90/270, retains x/y, and uses the original integer unit conversion. It is used for cached clearance rectangle endpoints (502-503), outside-board checks (539), doubled centers (595-596), and SVG dimensions (634-636). Searches found no remaining raw component-width/height geometry consumers outside the helper. Board dimensions are intentionally unchanged.
assessment.preservation: The squared-gap/positive-area predicate, signed arithmetic, upward half-span rounding, connectivity, validation ordering, finding ordering, sorted net reports and exact SVG fragments are unchanged. Rotation is not serialized and absent/zero/180 rotation retains original occupied extents.
assessment.tests: test_rotation.py includes an explicit asymmetric odd-size case with exact complete result/SVG, all four angles, changed clearance and net span, exact board-edge and outside placement, and millimeter scaling before span rounding. It checks malformed angles, missing/extra fields, schema precedence and escaped duplicate keys. Deterministic varied fixtures compare every output field to ordinary equivalent occupied rectangles across both units, negative coordinates, mixed rotations, nets and unconnected pins. Existing suites remain and the new suite is registered.
assessment.ownership_and_maintainability: The shared pure borrowed helper centralizes the changed rule without new allocations or workspace changes. The existing cached pair geometry remains cached. Changes stay within schema, affected geometry reads, tests and verification registration; no fixed-case special handling found.

limitations: Static source review only; no build or tests executed and no Guardian gate exercised. Runtime resource behavior and standard-library implementation were not independently validated.

Reviewed supplied public brief, contract and relevant library API notes plus baseline/submitted source and tests; avoided README historical timing text, parent trial state, private cases/grading, transcripts and new-run timing information.
